sample_size_rationale: Draft mechanical minimum only, not a power guarantee. Independent paired seeds with fresh within-pair shared initial population and centroids. Use separate 30-pair variance pilot; freeze n in [30,200] before confirmation, targeting >=90% modeled power per endpoint at true difference half the margin. No pilot pairs enter confirmation. If infeasible, report budget-limited precision and equivalence not established; do not widen margins.
